# Whirlwind Romance (G4)

Whirlwind Romance is a peach-gold Pegasus mare recognizable among the vacationers at Gladmane's Las Pegasus resort. Look for her dark rose/burgundy mane and tail, blue-violet eyes, and cutie mark combining a tornado with red hearts. She is a background character, not a principal player in the resort's storyline. [Pegasus character index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Pegasus_ponies).

**Names:** "Whirlwind Romance" is an unofficial community placeholder, not a verified name spoken in the show. Gameloft's licensed mobile game calls this same pony **Fancy Resortgoer**—an in-game label, not a secret identity or separate character. The precise origin of the community nickname is unverified.

**Speaking and appearances:** No individually verified dialogue or voice actor. Her documented appearances are *Viva Las Pegasus* (S6E20), *Grannies Gone Wild* (S8E5), and *Baby Flurry Heart's Heartfelt Scrapbook*, short 8, *Equestria: Land of Harmony*. [Scrapbook short reference](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Baby_Flurry_Heart%27s_Heartfelt_Scrapbook).

**Image:** [![Viva Las Pegasus episode montage](https://derpicdn.net/img/view/2021/1/12/2528654.png)](https://derpibooru.org/images/2528654)

*Hasbro television stills assembled into an episode montage (editor tag: quoterific); a cast-wide image, not an individual portrait.* Also see [Whirlwind Romance Waiting For A Date](https://www.deviantart.com/darksly-z/art/Whirlwind-Romance-Waiting-For-A-Date-Comm-Reward-811597069), fan artwork credited to **Darksly-z**.

## Important moments

She has no verified speaking, heroic, or plot-changing scenes; these are the two most useful on-screen recognition points, not a character arc.

1. **Las Pegasus debut — *Viva Las Pegasus* (S6E20).** She appears among Gladmane's resort guests in the setting where Applejack and Fluttershy investigate his operations. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHt6F0q2qPU); her exact on-screen timestamp is unverified.
2. **Return to Las Pegasus — *Grannies Gone Wild* (S8E5).** She reappears in the resort setting visited by Rainbow Dash and the Golden Horseshoe Gals, establishing her as a reused background guest. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bP4JTOPkyP0); her exact on-screen timestamp is unverified.
